description: This file defines a template class `OptionalType` within the `WPEFramework::Core` namespace, implementing an optional/nullable type for C++ that can hold a value of type `TYPE` or be empty. It includes constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and methods to check if a value is set, clear the value, and access the stored value.
